difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a commutative square of algebraic spaces over S with the vertical maps p and q etale, there is a canonical identification L_{X/Y}|_{U_etale} = L_{U/V} in D(O_U) (source lines 4418-4430). The proof uses that the formation of the cotangent complex commutes with pullback, together with the identifications p_{small}^{-1}O_X = O_U and g_{small}^{-1}O_{V_etale} = p_{small}^{-1}f_{small}^{-1}O_{Y_etale}, the latter because the pullback along an etale morphism of the structure sheaf is the structure sheaf; tracing through the definitions then gives the claim.
